title: AICA Acoustic Decorative Wall Panels Wood Veneer MDF Sound Proofing 120/240x60cm
body_html:
Boasting a minimalist profile, these wooden acoustic panels fit perfectly with most interior styles. They harmonize with all wall paint tones, bringing outstanding noise reduction and elegant texture to your room.

Our decorative acoustic panels are crafted from MDF with a sound absorption coefficient up to 0.7. Paired with high-density acoustic felt and wood slats, they deliver efficient sound absorption, boost sound clarity, reduce ambient noise, and effectively suppress echo and reverberation.

Flexible mounting: Panels can be installed horizontally or vertically to match your wall design.

Decorative Acoustic Wall Panels;Product Description

Decorative Acoustic Wall Panels:

  • Height: 60cm, Thickness: 2.1cm
  • Length:120cm / 240cm
  • Material: medium-density fiberboard (MDF).
  • Versatile: suitable for private spaces (living room, bedroom, office) as well as public places (restaurants, hotels, meeting rooms).
  • Natural wood effect: suitable for a wide range of settings, adds warmth and elegance.
  • Exceptional sound quality: With a sound absorption coefficient (SA) of up to 0.7, they create an exceptional acoustic environment.
  • Easy and flexible installation: Can be installed with glue or screws for quick installation. Easy to install with invisible joints; these acoustic wall panels are lighter than solid wood. Installation requires minimal effort and can be completed by one person. They can be precisely cut to fit spatial requirements, allowing you to freely customize your installation plan to perfectly meet personal needs, making them highly suitable for DIY enthusiasts.
  • Easy maintenance: These acoustic panels are easy to clean and maintain on a daily basis, and their surfaces do not easily accumulate dust. They can be easily wiped clean with a dry or slightly damp cloth.
  • Important Note: Leave a 5 mm gap between the panels and the floor to prevent moisture from rising through capillary action during floor cleaning and causing stains.
  • Warranty: 2 years.

title: AICA Stainless steel railing with 3 cross bars, lengths 80–240 cm, ideal for indoor stairs and patios
body_html:
AICA Stainless steel railing with 3 cross bars, lengths 80–240 cm, ideal for indoor stairs and patios

Railing Specifications & Description

Satin Brushed 201 Grade Stainless Steel Handrail:

  • Height: 106 cm, Handrail tube and post diameter: 42,4 mm, Small crossbar: 10 mm diameter, 1,15 mm wall thickness.
  • Available lengths: 80, 100, 120, 150, 180, 200, 220, 240 cm.
  • Material: 201 Stainless steel(an economical grade)
  • Ideal for indoor use or dry outdoor environments. Please note: prolonged exposure to wet or humid outdoor conditions may cause 201 stainless steel to rust. For outdoor use in damp weather, we recommend choosing our railing made of 304 stainless steel.
  • This railing features upgraded brackets and a thicker base for added strength and durability.
  • We offer matching railing connection kits, available for separate purchase. With these connectors, you can freely combine and extend railings of different sizes. You can find them in the "Connector Kit & Accessories" category of our store.
  • Safety: Available with 3 or 5 crossbar configurations, with multiple sizes to choose from. They are designed to provide more protection for you and your family while going up and down stairs.
  • Pre-installed with accessories on the pipe railing to save your installation time. It can be installed in no time, requiring only basic tools. Even if you're not a DIY expert, you can easily set them up.
  • Easy installation: Installation is very simple, with the intricate fittings on the handrail posts pre-installed.
  • High quality: Thickened, quality upgraded, strong coverage, environmental friendly, The best choice for home decoration.
  • Flexibility: This handrail is very flexible that ideal for use in different scenarios, slopes, ramps or steps.
  • Versatile Uses: Suitable for home, garden, hotel, porch, and other places with stairs or steps side wall. It serves as a support to improve security and convenience.
  • Handrails longer than 200cm come with 3 posts and are suitable for installation on level ground only, not for stair steps or ramps.
  • Care Instructions: Simply rinse with water or wipe off dirt with a cloth. To extend the service life of the railing, we recommend wiping it with a dry, clean cloth every 10-15 days. Dry any water stains promptly after cleaning to prevent limescale buildup and rusting. In humid environments (such as outdoor gardens, balconies, or coastal areas), the maintenance interval should be shortened to once a week. Do not use corrosive cleaning agents.
  • 【Note】To avoid corrosion and rusting caused by salt-laden air and precipitation, installation of this railing in coastal areas is not recommended. As the railing is made of 201 stainless steel, it may rust when used outdoors without regular maintenance and cleaning. If you have concerns about this, please consider carefully before purchasing. You may also consider purchasing our higher-quality 304 stainless steel railings or aluminum alloy railings. You can find these products in the "Railings" category of our store.
  • Warranty: 2 years.

Tile Backer boards

Tile Backer boards are specifically designed for two primary purposes:

  • 1.As a first-class heat insulation for underfloor heating system

  • 2.As a superior waterproof surface/construction board / to fix wall or floor tiles

    • Key Features:
  • The dimensions of each board are 1250mm x 600mm(0.75 metres); 6mm/25mm/40mm thick optional

  • Tile backer boards are particularly suited to underfloor heating mats and under tile heating cable applications

  • Will accept even the heaviest wall tiles, unlike plasterboard.(correct installation method must be followed)

  • Installation below underfloor heating systems on an existing un-insulated concrete or timber sub-floor will greatly reduce heat-up time and running costs

  • Our Tile Backer Boards will reduce the warm-up time of the heating and reduce your electricity bill

  • Use on walls and floors, ideal for wet rooms

  • Tile backer boards are waterproof and dimensionally stable (unlike plywood)

  • Excellent sound insulation: impact sound is greatly reduced

  • Can be Tiled, plastered or cladding applied

  • Offers fast creation of tiled partition walls anywhere within the home

  • High compression strength and lightweight

  • Easy to cut with sharp knife / fine tooth saw
